name: commit-append
description: Append every committed note (r1 >= 0) to the step's poly record at commit FUN_0801F32C. Hook 0x0801F32E reproduces strb.w r1,[r0,#0x2f5], then merges (note, velocity 100) into poly[track][step] with dedupe and an 8-note cap. Negative commits (rest/clear) are left to the clear cave.
